newsitem.title: UK: London Parcelforce workers vote to strike.
newsitem.headline: London Parcelforce workers vote to strike.

text.p: London workers at Royal Mail's parcel delivery unit Parcelforce have voted in favour of strike action after a ballot.
The Communications Workers' Union said more than 70 percent of the workers voted to strike, after a turn out above 80 percent.
The union said in a statement that the management were trying to impose "unnecessary and draconian attendance patterns."
In a seperate development, union officials met Royal Mail managers today to try to find a breakthrough to the long running dispute over pay, hours and working practices in the letter post.
The union has suggested a joint working party under an independent chairman to consider the controversial proposal to introduce teamworking into the postal service.
The Government has warned it will suspend the Royal Mail's monopoly on delivering letters for three months if further strikes are called.
